observations: Black motorcycle with a 'Kawasaki' logo on the fuel tank.
Two round analog gauges on the dashboard: a speedometer and a tachometer.
The motorcycle has a single-sided swingarm and a disc brake on the rear wheel.
The rear wheel has a red accent stripe on the rim.
The exhaust pipe is visible and appears to be a standard unit.
The motorcycle is parked against a textured concrete wall.

claims.evidence: The brand is Kawasaki, but the specific model (ZZR) and engine size are not visible on the tank or any other part shown.
No photo shows the engine running or the bike being ridden.

risks.risk: The engine may be seized or have significant internal damage.
risks.proof: A video of the engine running and the bike being ridden.

risks.risk: The odometer may be inaccurate or the bike may have been heavily modified.
risks.proof: A photo of the odometer reading and a photo of the engine identification plate.

risks.risk: The exhaust system may be leaking or the muffler may be damaged.
risks.proof: A video of the engine running with the exhaust sound.

proof_requests: Photo of the engine identification plate (usually on the right side of the engine).
Video of the engine running and the bike being ridden.
Photo of the front and rear suspension.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
